basics.name: Pedro Serrano
basics.label: Tech professional specializing in artificial intelligence
basics.summary: MSc in Mechanical Engineering, in automotive aftersales since 2013. I'm Parts & Accessories Manager and Team Leader at Astara Portugal, covering six brands, and I write the Python and SQL that automates our reporting — data extraction that took about six hours per brand now takes under one hour for all brands combined. My specialization in AI and deep learning (TensorFlow, Keras) is in progress. Interested in work where operational knowledge, automation and AI meet.

work.name: Astara Portugal
work.summary: Manage the parts and accessories department for Kia, Mitsubishi Motors, Fuso, Isuzu, Maxus and KGM in Portugal: inventory, OEM and dealer relations, sales and planning.
highlights: Lead a team of three: two network parts managers and one data-analysis intern.
Automated the data extraction behind aftersales reporting with Python and SQL: from about 6 hours per brand to under 1 hour for all brands combined.
Replaced separate per-brand management reports with a single consolidated view for senior management.
